source_snapshot.items: Check BMC version from BIOS / ipmi / BMC Web / redfish
source_snapshot.procedure: Compare BIOS Server Mgmt, in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI, BMC Web and Redfish Manager version; source embeds default credentials, curl -k and log clearing.
source_snapshot.criteria: All BMC versions should be correct.
source_snapshot.script: Private check-bmc-version-from-bios_ipmi_bmc-web_redfish path; 10 attended and 20 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES with out-of-band ipmitool and Redfish only; omits BIOS, in-band IPMI and Web, filters raw evidence, disables TLS and calls the case no-risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; five-surface same-manager correlation, protected credentials, version normalization and operator evidence are required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Rejected as complete automation because two commands cover only two of five required views and do not prove same-manager identity or safe credential/TLS handling.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassification and full five-surface evidence contract are accepted; no firmware update or configuration action is part of this read-only comparison.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or completed record; generic BMC version rows cannot replace the specific five-interface parity requirement.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Firmware strings may differ by build suffix, active image or vendor formatting, so identity and an approved normalization map must precede comparison rather than stripping output with grep.

original_test_intent: Verify that BIOS Server Management, in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI, BMC Web and Redfish all report the owner-approved version for the same BMC manager.
original_method: Bind one SUT/BMC by serial, manager identity and endpoints; collect complete version/build evidence from all five named surfaces through protected sessions and operator captures; normalize only documented aliases and reconcile every source with the expected active firmware without mutating the BMC.
manual_activity: An operator captures BIOS Server Management and BMC Web values and verifies their manager identity; automation collects complete in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI and Redfish version evidence for the same BMC.
required_inputs: Exact SUT and BMC manager identity
Expected active BMC firmware version and build
BIOS Server Management and BMC Web operator access
Supported in-band and out-of-band ipmitool paths
Protected credentials and validated TLS/host policy
Private script revision or equivalent reviewed procedure
safety_requirements: Do not use source default credentials
Do not expose passwords in command lines or logs
Do not disable TLS validation without an approved bounded exception
Do not compare endpoints until same-manager identity is proven
Do not filter away build or auxiliary version fields
Do not update firmware or change BMC configuration
Do not clear SEL, audit, dmesg or syslog
agent_execution_scope: Perform read-only in-band and out-of-band mc info collection
Read the canonical Redfish Manager version fields through protected authentication
Coordinate and label operator BIOS/Web captures
Report mismatches and access gaps without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve expected version/build and normalization rules
Verify BIOS and Web observations and manager identity
Interpret active/staged or alias discrepancies and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The IPMI and Redfish reads cover only part of the source, and grep plus jq.FirmwareVersion can discard build/context fields; BIOS, in-band IPMI and Web evidence remain missing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete protected in-band and out-of-band `ipmitool mc info`, canonical Redfish Manager version/build JSON, and operator-labelled BIOS Server Management and BMC Web captures for the same verified manager; compare under the owner normalization matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five named surfaces and 10/20-minute estimates remain; default credentials, `-k`, log clearing and two-surface substitution are rejected.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an evidence table with source, manager identity, raw version/build, normalized value, active/staged meaning, timestamp and expected-value comparison for BIOS, IB IPMI, OOB IPMI, Web and Redfish.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity correlation, secure sessions, complete raw fields and explicit normalization instead of a two-command filtered comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation covers three command/API views; the two graphical surfaces still require operator capture unless a separately validated UI interface exists.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Version aliases, cached Web data or active/staged images can look inconsistent; wrong endpoint correlation can point future firmware work at the wrong manager.

project_override_considerations: A Project may replace a manual view only with a validated equivalent that proves the same displayed value and manager identity. Any firmware change to resolve a mismatch is a separate approval-gated testcase.
expected_evidence: Redacted SUT/BMC/manager identity and endpoint correlation
Owner expected active version/build and normalization map
Complete BIOS, in-band IPMI, out-of-band IPMI, BMC Web and Redfish version evidence
Source-labelled raw and normalized comparison with timestamps/status
TLS/credential/redaction and no-mutation audit plus preserved existing events
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require five BMC version views. The incomplete and insecure DeepSeek command is a coverage defect, not a contradiction in the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is clear and becomes executable with normal packages, protected credentials, operator access, expected version and normalization inputs.

review_improvement: Restores the three omitted version surfaces, binds all evidence to one manager and replaces embedded credentials/TLS bypass with protected, auditable collection.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two identical strings do not prove five-view parity if they came from different managers or omit build/active-image context. Correlating manager identity and retaining each raw representation is necessary before controlled normalization can show whether every interface exposes the same firmware state.
